headline: Apple Begins Long-Delayed Trial of AI Tools for Chinese Users
summary: Apple initiated a trial rollout of in-house artificial intelligence tools for users in China, marking a step to catch up with domestic smartphone competitors in a key market.
why: Deploying artificial intelligence features in regulated international markets is critical for hardware manufacturers to maintain device competitiveness and consumer demand.

impacts.name: Apple Inc.
impacts.why: Apple rolled out trial in-house AI tools for Chinese users.
